family.description: This family of proteins the superfamily of PHD-finger proteins. At least one example, from mouse, may act as a chromatin-associated protein[[cite:PUB00020105]]. The S. pombe ini1 gene is essential, required for splicing [[cite:PUB00020106]]. It is localised in the nucleus, but not detected in the nucleolus and can be complemented by human ini1 [[cite:PUB00020106]].
family.name: PHF5-like protein
